HOOPS.gloss: a game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players
HOOPS.definition: A game played on a court by two opposing teams of 5 players; points are scored by throwing the ball through an elevated horizontal hoop.

SHOP.gloss: a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
SHOP.definition: A mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services.
SHOP.example: He bought it at a shop on Cape Cod.

HOOP.gloss: a light curved skeleton to spread out a skirt
HOOP.definition: A light curved skeleton to spread out a skirt.

HOPS.gloss: twining perennials having cordate leaves and flowers arranged in conelike spikes
HOPS.definition: Twining perennials having cordate leaves and flowers arranged in conelike spikes; the dried flowers of this plant are used in brewing to add the characteristic bitter taste to beer.

OOH.gloss: express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'
OOH.definition: Express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'.
OOH.example: They oohed and aahed when they unwrapped the presents.
